verdict.rationale: Fly.io describes usage-based billing ('you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use'). It also says Sprites sleep until needed and MCP servers on Sprites are billed only for the tool calls used, which points toward paying for active time rather than idle time. However, the evidence never says how general Fly Machines are metered (per running second vs. active request time), and there is no documented auto-stop or scale-to-zero billing behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that idle or stopped Machines incur no compute charges, auto-stop/scale-to-zero configuration details, billing granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration of actual billing behavior.
